name: h2o_ccpvdz_dipole
description: #517: h2o_ccpvdz_j's molecule, basis and recorded density, with libcint's int1e_r_cart (<m|r - C|n>, components x, y, z) under mol.with_common_orig(C) at C = (0.37, -0.81, 1.23) bohr and at C = 0, and PySCF's RHF dip_moment (a.u., nuclear minus electronic) for the recorded density at both, with the nuclear charges and coordinates it used.

provenance.command: PYTHONPATH=test uv run --group oracle python -m oracle.generate --regenerate h2o_ccpvdz_dipole

density_recipe: hilbert: D[i][j] = 1/(i+j+1) -- symmetric positive definite, no RNG, reproducible bit-for-bit on any host
